name: Carlos Chan Ka-lok
bio: Carlos Chan Ka-lok is a Hong Kong actor. Discovered by Emperor Entertainment Group through a singing contest, Chan initially signed as a singer. He made his onscreen debut with a minor role in the action film Connected, and went on to star in various productions in small parts. most well-known for Happiness (2016), Legally Declared Dead (2019) and The Unwavering Brotherhood (2024). He has been married to Shiga Lin Si-nga since 24 April 2023. They have one child.
